capabilities: Merge JPG/PNG/WebP images into PDFs with page ordering and rotation
OCR scanned pages with built-in Tesseract, optional Paddle, or optional MinerU
Create and edit nested PDF bookmarks with page preview and undo
Calibrate printed book contents pages to physical PDF page numbers
Export searchable PDFs with selectable text layers, singly or as ZIP batches
disambiguation: Not a web-article bookmarking service; it creates outline bookmarks inside PDFs from paper headings and scanned book contents.
extras: The plugin is about 17 MB because OCR models are bundled, exceeding the Obsidian Sync Standard 5 MB file limit, so it must be installed separately on each desktop device with that plan. A standalone browser version (online or offline HTML file) with the same features is also available. Built-in local OCR is free and needs no account; MinerU may require a paid API plan.
problem: Obsidian offers no built-in way to make scanned PDFs searchable or to build and correct outline bookmarks for papers and scanned books.

relations.evidence: PDF layout and bookmark foundations are adapted from Note and PDF Voice Reader / note-reader-core
